label: 何叔衡考入湖南省立第四师范讲习科
text: 37 岁入学，是当时年龄最大的学生。
label_en: He Shuheng enters the Fourth Normal School
text_en: He enrolled at 37, the oldest student of his cohort.

label: 第四师范并入湖南省立第一师范
text: 毛泽东编入第八班，杨昌济讲授修身学。
label_en: The Fourth Normal School merges into Hunan First Normal
text_en: Mao was placed in Class Eight; Yang Changji taught self-cultivation.

label: 《体育之研究》发表
text: 以“二十八画生”笔名发表于《新青年》。
text_en: Published in New Youth under the pen name 'Ershibahuasheng'.

label: 与萧子升徒步游学
text: 不带分文，徒步五县，读“无字之书”。
label_en: Walking study tour with Xiao Zisheng
text_en: Penniless, they walked through five counties, 'reading the book without words'.

label: 新民学会成立
text: 毛泽东、蔡和森、萧子升等发起，何叔衡为最年长会员。
label_en: The New People's Study Society is founded
text_en: Initiated by Mao, Cai Hesen and Xiao Zisheng; He Shuheng was its oldest member.

label: 杨昌济自北京来信
text: 传递留法勤工俭学消息，推动毛泽东等人赴京。
text_en: He sent news of the work-study programme in France, prompting Mao to travel to Beijing.

label: 《湘江评论》创刊
text: 毛泽东在长沙创办，传播新思想。
text_en: Founded by Mao in Changsha to spread new ideas.

label: 驱逐张敬尧运动
text: 青年毛泽东的重要政治实践。
text_en: An important political practice of the young Mao.

label: 湖南共产党早期组织成立
text: 何叔衡与毛泽东共同发起。
label_en: Early Communist organisation formed in Hunan
text_en: Jointly initiated by He Shuheng and Mao Zedong.

label: 出席中共一大
text: 何叔衡与毛泽东一同赴上海出席。
label_en: Delegates to the CPC's First Congress
text_en: He Shuheng and Mao Zedong travelled to Shanghai together.
